items.meetings_sql: SELECT node_id,canonicalMeetingNumber,meetingNumberInt FROM Meeting ORDER BY meetingNumberInt,canonicalMeetingNumber
items.source_relation_sql:
SELECT m.node_id,m.canonicalMeetingNumber,m.meetingNumberInt,
                                r.node_id,r.resolutionId,t.node_id,t.tdocNumber,c.companyName
                         FROM Resolution r
                         JOIN rel_MADE_AT at ON at.src_id=r.node_id
                         JOIN Meeting m ON m.node_id=at.dst_id
                         JOIN rel_REFERENCES ref ON ref.src_id=r.node_id
                         JOIN Tdoc t ON t.node_id=ref.dst_id
                         JOIN rel_SUBMITTED_BY sub ON sub.src_id=t.node_id
                         JOIN Company c ON c.node_id=sub.dst_id
                         WHERE c.companyName=?
                         ORDER BY m.node_id,r.node_id,t.node_id
items.scope: Every frozen source Meeting is an observation coordinate; zeros mean no qualifying recorded relation, never complete real-world inactivity.

items.source_relation_sql:
SELECT m.node_id,m.canonicalMeetingNumber,m.meetingNumberInt,
                                s.node_id,s.summaryId,c.companyName
                         FROM Summary s
                         JOIN rel_MADE_AT at ON at.src_id=s.node_id
                         JOIN Meeting m ON m.node_id=at.dst_id
                         JOIN rel_MODERATED_BY mod ON mod.src_id=s.node_id
                         JOIN Company c ON c.node_id=mod.dst_id
                         WHERE c.companyName=?
                         ORDER BY m.node_id,s.node_id
